description: Find AI and software tools tracked on usedby by name, other product name, or what they do (category, topic or task, in English, French, Spanish, German or Portuguese, e.g. 'CRM', 'contract management', 'gestion des contrats'), with how many companies publicly use each.

limit.description: Rows to list (default 25, max 100). The usedby page has the full list.

query.description: Tool name, category or task, e.g. 'cursor', 'coding', 'customer support', 'contract management'.

name: search_tools

error.description: Set only when the input matched nothing or was invalid.

message.description: What went wrong, with the next step, when error is set.

source.description: The usedby page to cite: quote with a link to source.url.

suggestions.description: Close matches to ask again with, when error is not_found.

tools.description: Matching tools, with their public customer counts.

customers.description: Public lines: all, confirmed or observed, job-post signals.

match.description: How the tool matched: name (or another name of the product), topic (category, family or tag), close (a near spelling: check it).

title: Search tools
